title: Dual module sheaf and its ordered evaluation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Using the internal sheaf Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom], define $M^\vee=\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_X}(M,\mathcal O_X)$. Using the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], define evaluation $M\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}M^\vee\to\mathcal O_X$ as the sheafification of the sectionwise internal-Hom evaluation $m\otimes\lambda\mapsto\lambda(m)$, followed by the sheafification counit. No local-freeness or invertibility is required for either definition.
